title.vi: Đạo luật sửa đổi Đạo luật số 78 nhan đề 'Đạo luật tuyên bố tất cả những người cầm vũ khí chống lại chính quyền Hoa Kỳ tại Quần đảo Philippines và tất cả những người hỗ trợ hoặc xúi giục họ vào ngày 1 tháng 4 năm 1901 hoặc sau đó không đủ tư cách đảm nhiệm chức vụ', Đạo luật Chính quyền Tỉnh và Bộ luật Thị trấn ở những điều khoản liên quan
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแก้ไขพระราชบัญญัติฉบับที่78เรื่องการประกาศให้บุคคลทั้งหมดที่ถืออาวุธต่อต้านอำนาจสหรัฐอเมริกาในหมู่เกาะฟิลิปปินส์และบุคคลทั้งหมดที่ให้ความช่วยเหลือหรือยุยงส่งเสริมพวกเขาในวันที่1เมษายนพ.ศ.2444หรือหลังจากนั้นไม่มีคุณสมบัติในการดำรงตำแหน่งทางการเมืองพระราชบัญญัติการปกครองจังหวัดและประมวลกฎหมายเทศบาลในบทที่เกี่ยวข้อง
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Undang-Undang Nomor 78 berjudul 'Undang-Undang menyatakan semua orang yang bersenjata melawan otoritas Amerika Serikat di Kepulauan Filipina dan semua orang yang membantu atau mendorong mereka pada tanggal 1 April 1901 atau setelahnya tidak memenuhi syarat untuk menduduki jabatan', Undang-Undang Pemerintahan Provinsi dan Kode Kota di pasal-pasal terkait
title.ms: Akta mengubah Akta Nombor 78 bertajuk 'Akta yang mengisytiharkan semua orang yang bersenjata menentang kuasa Amerika Syarikat di Kepulauan Filipina dan semua orang yang membantu atau menghasut mereka pada 1 April 1901 atau selepas itu tidak layak memegang jawatan', Akta Kerajaan Wilayah dan Kod Bandaran dalam bahagian yang berkaitan

text.en:
An Act Numbered Seventy-eight, entitled "An Act declaring all persons in arms against the
authority of the United States in the Philippine Islands, and all persons aiding or abetting them, on the first
day of April, nineteen hundred and one, or thereafter, ineligible to hold office," is hereby amended by
striking out the word "April" in the first line of section one and inserting in lieu thereof the word "May."

Act Numbered Eighty-two, entitled "A general Act for the organization of municipal governments
in the Philippine Islands," is hereby amended by striking out the word "April" in the first line of subsection
(d), section eight, and inserting in lieu thereof the word "May."

Act Numbered Eighty-three, entitled "A general Act for the organization of provincial
governments in the Philippine Islands," is hereby amended by striking out the word "April" in the eleventh
line of section three, and inserting in lieu thereof the word "May."

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, March 22, 1901.
